Beyond-individual AI is about collectives: research federations, engineering agent networks, human-AI discovery platforms, and reproducibility infrastructure. The established science behind Human-AI Collective Discovery Platform rests on Distributed cognition: networks of specialized agents plus humans can solve problems no single system can, if coordination, verification, and incentives work.
